head.i: Magistratus alii foris rem administrantes. Itemque Magistratus urbani, praetores & quaestores.

main_text.p: Præter hos, qui arma tractabant, erant foris rempublicam gerentes regionum imperio Punico parentium præsides, & urbium præfecti, à civitate dati. Et fuisse etiam vectigalium & tributorum, quæ à subditis populis pendebantur, coactores, dubium esse non potest, quamvis monumenta veterum de iis silent. In urbanis verò magistratibus fuisse prætores & quæstores jam antè nobis nominatos, historiæ loquuntur. Nam Annibalem Carthagine prætorem creatum anno quinto post finem belli diuturni ab ipso contra Romanos gesti, Livius prodit, idemque affirmat Æmilius Probus in vitâ ipsius. Quod sanè arguit haud parvæ dignitatis prætoram[?] illic fuisse, quippe Annibali collatam, & ab eo administratam post tantas res jam antè gestas, & tantam gloriam comparatam, ut esset nunc in tota ea gente longè clarissimus. page.notes: The initial "P" is a drop capital and is joined to "ræter" as "Præter". The first word is partly obscured by the drop capital; "Præter" is my reading. "prætoram" (line 14 of the paragraph) is a doubtful reading of a word in the scan and should be checked against the original. The æ and ligatures in "prætores", "quæstores" and "Æmilius" are inferred from the printing style. The catchword "grasse" is hard to read at this resolution. The left margin shows scan-edge marks and show-through, which are not transcribed.
